projectTitle: Courier Android SDK (courier.com): Notification Inbox, Push and Preferences
description: Official Kotlin SDK for Courier (courier.com), the notification platform. Add a prebuilt in-app notification Inbox (Jetpack Compose and Views), Firebase (FCM) push notifications with token sync and delivery tracking, and a notification preference center to Android apps.
rules: Install from JitPack: add maven { url 'https://jitpack.io' } and implementation 'com.github.trycourier:courier-android:<version>'.
Sign in with Courier.shared.signIn(userId = userId, accessToken = jwt). It is a suspend function: call it from a coroutine.
Use the CourierInbox composable or view for the prebuilt Inbox, and Courier.shared.addInboxListener for a custom UI. Remove listeners on teardown.
For push, subclass FirebaseMessagingService and forward onNewToken and onMessageReceived to Courier; extend CourierActivity to get delivery and click events.
Mint the Courier JWT on your backend with your Courier API key (POST /auth/issue-token). Never put the API key in the app.
Call signIn once, after your own login resolves. Credentials persist across app launches. Call signOut when the user logs out.
The user_id in the JWT scope must match the userId passed to signIn, or the Inbox loads empty.
Scopes: inbox:read:messages inbox:write:events for Inbox; add read:preferences write:preferences for preferences and write:user-tokens for push.
Always set expires_in when minting. The SDK does not refresh tokens: mint a new JWT and call signIn again before it expires.
EU workspaces: mint the JWT at https://api.eu.courier.com/auth/issue-token and pass EU apiUrls to signIn. Token and client must be in the same region.
